headline: Battery report, smarter battery warnings, fresh readings

items.title: Battery report
items.line: See your real-world range over time, with alerts as the battery ages. Tap Health on the Battery page.

items.title: Smarter battery warnings
items.line: “Above usual” now starts at your own normal. A new warning speaks up when something looks mechanical: drag, or a battery draining too fast.

items.title: Ride screen waits for the ride
items.line: Turning the scooter on and wheeling it out records quietly. The ride screen opens when you ride off.

items.title: Fresh readings every time
items.line: Nothing from your last ride shows as now: no more “Engine hot” at the start.

full: Battery report: range on a full battery in km next to health %, a graph you can press for date, km and %, how fast it drops and when the next level comes.
Battery notices at every 5 % of health lost from 90 %: Battery decay detected, Battery wearing, Battery worn. Never during a ride; each once.
Battery health compares rides in similar weather, so winter is not counted as wear. “I replaced the battery” starts a new baseline.
Above usual battery use starts at your own 9-in-10 line for the route. Extreme use (likely mechanical) speaks at once and leaves a note on the ride page.
Every scooter reading starts empty on a new connection; engine lines only after the motor has run on this ride.
The ride screen opens at the real ride start or when you press Start.
Places can be 25 m or 50 m.
Fuel price: type 3 digits, the point goes in by itself.
Unused code removed.

headline: Hotfix: the arrival battery is right again, one battery everywhere

items.title: Arrival battery fixed
items.line: It was saying your battery now. Your past rides on the route count again, so it says what you will arrive with.

items.title: No repeats
items.line: No arrival line when little is left to use, and never the same number as the line just before.

items.title: Checked on your rides
items.line: Developer → Voice replay now fails a ride where the arrival equals the battery now.

items.title: Scooter tab matches Home
items.line: After Unplugged, the next real reading replaces the estimate. The Scooter tab shows the same last reading as Home.

full: Past rides are stored a row about every 5 seconds; the arrival maths skipped every row, so each past ride seemed to use nothing. Every row counts now, live and stored.
A past ride that seems to use almost nothing while its battery fell is left out.
No arrival battery line with under 5 points left to use; never the battery now; never the same number as the line just before.
Voice replay checks that halfway the arrival is below the battery now.
After Unplugged, connecting the scooter (or the next ride) ends the ≈ estimate and counts that charge as measured for your charging speed.
With the scooter off, the Scooter tab and Home show the same last reading and time.

headline: Hotfix: a voice you can trust

items.title: Arrival battery that holds
items.line: Hills no longer set it off. It speaks only when sure, compares with your own rides, and never says a higher number after a lower one.

items.title: Late means late
items.line: Late is against today's estimate, from a third of the way on: “Running 6 minutes late, arriving at 9:02.” An early red light is not late.

items.title: One line to start
items.line: A few seconds after you set off: “Riding to Uni, arriving at 8:56, battery at 98 percent.”

full: The arrival battery is worked out from the energy you use, so a hill at full throttle no longer makes it jump.

It is compared point by point with your past rides on the route, said only after it holds steady for a minute, never in the first 2 km, rounded to 5, and only when 5 points worse than the last; better stays quiet, with one “Back on track” at 10 better.
Running late is measured against the time the Where-to chip promised today, only from a third of the route, held a minute, and only when slower than most of your rides there.
The ride screen's arrival time no longer jumps later after an early red light.
Start line: where you are riding, when you arrive and your battery, once.
After a ride, the summary (More) shows what the voice said next to what really happened.
Developer: Voice replay tries the new voice on your newest rides.

headline: Places with real shapes, honest insights, and a voice that helps you plan

items.title: Voice energy updates
items.line: Every 10 %, using more than usual, running late, engine heat and “Arrived at Uni, battery at 58%”. Urgent ones at once, the rest at a stop.

items.title: Draw your places
items.line: Give a place its real outline. Arriving counts the moment you cross in; rides that stay inside show as “Around Uni”.

items.title: Insights that say how far they are
items.line: “About 7 more rides”, graphs that are solid where you rode and dashed where data is thin, and small riding asks.

items.title: Charging you can read
items.line: Your last reading and its time on Home, one full time, and a battery on the Lock Screen that fills and counts down by itself.

full: Every ride map draws the route as a thin, even line whose colour changes along the ride.
The Battery layer marks 90%, 80% … where the battery first dropped below each 10 %.
Scooter off: Home shows your last reading and its time (66% · 07:49); the small pill reads Charge to 100%.
Charging: the estimate starts from your last real reading and the screen shows one full time.
Lock Screen and Dynamic Island count down to your target and fill a battery shape on their own; no frozen % number.
Rides brought back with Restore are saved to the backup folder like any ride, so they travel with your data.
Places: Circle or an Outline you draw (tap corners, drag, add a corner between two, Undo, Reset). Rides that stay inside are listed as Around <place> and do not change estimates.
A trip's usual time shows only where that trip starts; elsewhere just the place name.
Ride graph: a tap adds or removes a line; ⇄ switches a line to its deeper view (Speed ⇄ Accel). Pinch zooms time, a one-finger swipe up or down changes the scale.
Ride detail plays back like Replay: the speed strip, play, 1× / 5× / 20× and a dot moving on the map.
Insights learn from whole rides (Hills, Speed, Battery over time, Cold, Wind, Best time to leave) and say how many more rides they need; the old speed sweet spot is gone.
The speed card asks for one small steady stretch on a straight, flat part of your routes; Not here picks another place; Got it ✓ when it is done.
The charging speed is learned from your own Plug ins.
The app learns where your scooter starts holding back power at low battery (after a ride below 15 %); until then nothing changes.
Voice energy updates while riding, with an on/off switch in Settings → Sounds.

headline: Hotfix: route colours, sweet spot and clearer charts

items.title: Route colours along the line
items.line: The ride map shows the colour changing along the route again, not one shade for the whole ride.

items.title: Speed sweet spot works
items.line: It now finds your steady stretches, so it can start learning your best cruising speed.

items.title: Clearer Stats chart
items.line: Round dashed lines on the bars' own scale, centred wider bars, your best day in red.

items.title: Ride graph
items.line: Pinch sideways for time, up-down for values; tap a chip again for its deeper line; the map shows the part you look at.

full: The ride map and Replay show the colour changing along the route again.
Developer: Route line lab compares three ways of drawing the route.
Speed sweet spot finds steady stretches again (it wanted readings closer together than rides store).
Stats: dashed lines in round steps, the top one about at the tallest bar, on the bars' own scale.
Stats: bars centred on their day, wider with a gap; the tallest is red.
Ride graph: pinch sideways to zoom time, up-down to stretch the values; drag to move along the ride.
Ride graph: tap Speed, Battery or Height again for acceleration, battery per km or incline.
Ride graph: the part of the ride on the graph is orange on the map; Hills jumps to a climb; Select and Scatter are gone.

headline: Rides are never lost, and the map says more

items.title: No more lost rides
items.line: A ride starts when you really ride, stays on while you ride, and is kept even if the phone took over.

items.title: Where to? from anywhere
items.line: Pick your destination from the Scooter on notification, or change it at a stop.

items.title: Ride map layers
items.line: Speed, Hills, Wind, Battery and Temp on one smooth line; tap a layer again for a deeper view.

items.title: Plug in after every ride
items.line: One tap starts the charge timer; the small pill sets when to tell you.

full: Battery % no longer jumps between 100 and 99.
A ride with real GPS distance is never thrown away; Restore discarded ride in Rides.
Ride start and end battery use settled readings: no more 99 % → 100 %.
A ride ends at your last movement; short stops still count in its time.
Auto-started rides begin at your first real riding movement.
Legs to the same destination become one ride, with ↻ Continue to … when you did not arrive.
Bad scooter readings are trimmed, never the whole ride, and trust comes back by itself.
A ride is not ended while the scooter is on or you are moving.
Riding to Uni, 8 km: the destination is said when you set off; change it at a stop.
Pick your destination from the Scooter on notification.
Never two rows for the same place in Where to?.
Arrival times in Where to? are always current.
Destinations show time and battery: Home • 30 mins • 27% battery.
The quick dial is always on Home.
Hold a place to drag it into a new order; let go for its menu.
The › in the Places list sits inside its card.
No parked pin on Home's map.
Shared energy track: battery use spread along the ride by power.
Map layers Speed · Hills · Wind · Battery · Temp, tap again for a deeper view, stops as dots.
The route is one smooth gradient line.
The ride summary map takes about half the screen.
The route draws itself smoothly after a ride.
Drag the ride card like Apple Maps, down to a small lip.
Plug in after every ride: one tap, an alert you choose, an honest time.
One clear Stats chart with km, rides, time or ₪ saved.
Insights show how far along they are; sure ones get their own page.
One ride graph with chips, linked to the map, with a scatter view.
Version names like 101.251026.00 everywhere.
This card: what is new after each update.
